items.content: Exactly two JUnit 5 probes in ConfigParserTest. Control: parse <config><name>billing</name></config> and assert serviceName returns billing. Exploit: parse a document whose DOCTYPE declares an external entity for file:///etc/hostname referenced inside <name>, and assert org.xml.sax.SAXParseException from ConfigParser.serviceName. ConfigParser.serviceName owns parser hardening; the JDK parser is used as is.
Uploaded service configuration XML is parsed by ConfigParser.serviceName. A DOCTYPE with an external entity may make the parser read local files into the service name.
